data.desc: Paradium. AI, Inc. (NYSE American: PAAI) is an AI-driven technology platform operating at the intersection of IP, data and commerce engineered to empower creators, media entrepreneurs, publishers and brands to perform at the speed and scale of AI. Powered by our flagship technologies Encore, InfoSentience and Cutter Studios, our unified ecosystem combines cutting-edge AI technology, multi-channel distribution, and scalable monetization. Anchored by our owned portfolio of iconic brands, including Parade, The Street, Men's Journal, and Athlon Sports, we provide the tools, data and reach that enable businesses to serve and grow audiences and unlock long-term value. Visit us at Paradium.AI to learn more.
